title: Fix linear gradient fill SWF export: 27% visual oracle mismatch (over 20% threshold)
description:
The new visual-oracle E2E fixture 'linear gradient fill renders consistently' (apps/desktop/e2e/visual-oracle.spec.ts) fails with 27% pixel mismatch — above the 20% threshold.

The fixture creates a rectangle with a red-to-blue horizontal linear gradient fill and compares CanvasRenderer vs Ruffle output. A 27% mismatch on a simple gradient suggests a coordinate system or color stop encoding issue rather than a complete failure.

Likely causes to investigate:
1. Gradient matrix / transform encoding: the SWF GRADIENT record's focal point, spread mode, or interpolation mode may differ from what the Canvas renderer uses. Check packages/swf/src/shapes.ts encodeGradient() — specifically the MATRIX record for the gradient transform (should map the canonical gradient space [-16384, 16384] twips to the shape's bounding box).
2. Color stop positions off-by-one: SWF gradient color stops use 0-255 range; verify the ratio-to-byte mapping in the encoder.
3. Spread mode mismatch: if the gradient matrix maps larger than the shape, the spread mode (pad/reflect/repeat) determines edge behavior — default should be 'pad' (0).
4. Linear vs radial selection: confirm the SWF GRADIENT fillStyle byte is 0x10 (linear) not 0x12 (radial).

Debug: save attached PNGs from the failing test run. Compare gradient direction and color coverage between CanvasRenderer and Ruffle screenshots.

Acceptance: the linear gradient fixture passes at <= 20% mismatch.
